recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist album layout featuring a white top header bar and a large, sepia-toned gestural ink sketch below. The sketch depicts a dynamic scene of a horse-drawn carriage in motion, rendered with rapid, overlapping lines that suggest speed and energy. The typography is split between elegant script and stark, modern serifs.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the clean white header and the textured, aged paper sketch area
Juxtaposition of fluid, calligraphic script with rigid, geometric serifs
Kinetic energy of the messy sketch versus the organized, horizontal alignment of the text
coreInvariants: Off-white or cream-colored paper texture for the illustration area
Dark brown or sepia ink for the sketch lines
A distinct horizontal division separating the title area from the artwork

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The sketch occupies the bottom 80% of the frame, centered but with asymmetrical weight towards the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, concentrated lines of the carriage wheels and the horse's head.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left script, move across the horizontal header, then drop into the swirling, circular motion of the sketch lines.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The stark white header provides breathing room against the dense, chaotic lines of the drawing.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cream/Off-white background for the sketch area.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the top header bar.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep burgundy or dark red for the secondary title.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the white header and the dark ink lines.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of copperplate script and transitional serif.
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses high-contrast, slanted script with ornate loops.
Secondary text uses all-caps, medium-weight serif with wide tracking.
Accent text uses bold, condensed serif with a slight upward rotation.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' and 'T' in the script have elongated, flourished tails.
The accent word is rotated approximately 15 degrees upward.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Formal script paired with a utilitarian serif for a 'classic meets modern' feel.

preserve: The contrast between script and serif
The upward tilt of the right-hand text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the ornate, high-contrast script style.
Provides the clean, traditional serif look for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned, gestural ink and graphite sketch of a horse-drawn carriage in rapid motion on cream-colored textured paper. The top 20% of the image should be a solid, flat white bar separated by a thin red horizontal line.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a dark grey calligraphic script title on the left of the white bar. Add a burgundy, bold, condensed serif word on the right of the white bar, tilted upwards at a 15-degree angle.

verificationChecks: Is the sketch rendered with loose, kinetic lines?
Is there a clear white header at the top?
Is the right-side text tilted upwards?
Is the color palette limited to sepia, white, and burgundy?

adjustableVariables: Degree of rotation for the accent text

mustAchieve: Clean, professional typesetting in the header
Sense of motion through line work

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the sketch does not bleed into the white header.
Check that the script font is legible despite the flourishes.
Verify the sepia tone feels like aged paper, not a digital filter.
Confirm the burgundy text is the only saturated color element.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a chaotic, gestural ink drawing on aged paper with a structured, minimalist white header containing high-contrast typographic pairings.
